sn3.25:1.1: sāvatthīnidānaṃ. atha kho rājā pasenadikosalo divādivassa yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn3.25:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho rājānaṃ pasenadikosalaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
sn3.25:1.3: handa kuto nu tvaṃ mahārāja āgacchasi divādivassāti.
sn3.25:1.4: yāni tāni bhante raññaṃ khattiyānaṃ muddhāvasittānaṃ issariyamadamattānaṃ kāmagedhapariyuṭṭhitānaṃ janapadatthāvariyappattānaṃ mahantaṃ paṭhavīmaṇḍalaṃ abhivijiya ajjhāvasantānaṃ rājakaraṇīyāni bhavanti tesvāhaṃ etarahi ussukkaṃ āpannoti.
sn3.25:2.2: idha te puriso āgaccheyya puratthimāya disāya saddhāyiko paccayiko
sn3.25:2.4: yagghe mahārāja jāneyya ahaṃ āgacchāmi puratthimāya disāya
sn3.25:2.5: tatthaddasaṃ mahantaṃ pabbataṃ abbhasamaṃ sabbe pāṇe nippothento āgacchati
sn3.25:2.7: atha dutiyo puriso āgaccheyya dakkhiṇāya disāya …pe… atha tatiyo puriso āgaccheyya pacchimāya disāya …pe…
sn3.25:2.9: catuttho puriso āgaccheyya uttarāya disāya saddhāyiko paccayiko
sn3.25:2.11: yagghe mahārāja jāneyya ahaṃ āgacchāmi uttarāya disāya
sn3.25:2.12: tatthaddasaṃ mahantaṃ pabbataṃ abbhasamaṃ sabbe pāṇe nippothento āgacchati
sn3.25:2.14: evarūpe te mahārāja mahati mahabbhaye samuppanne dāruṇe manussakkhaye dullabhe manussatte kimassa karaṇīyanti.
sn3.25:3.1: evarūpe me bhante mahati mahabbhaye samuppanne dāruṇe manussakkhaye dullabhe manussatte kimassa karaṇīyaṃ aññatra dhammacariyāya aññatra samacariyāya aññatra kusalakiriyāya aññatra puññakiriyāyāti.
sn3.25:4.1: ārocemi kho te mahārāja paṭivedemi kho te mahārāja adhivattati kho taṃ mahārāja jarāmaraṇaṃ
sn3.25:4.2: adhivattamāne ca te mahārāja jarāmaraṇe kimassa karaṇīyanti.
sn3.25:4.3: adhivattamāne ca me bhante jarāmaraṇe kimassa karaṇīyaṃ aññatra dhammacariyāya aññatra samacariyāya aññatra kusalakiriyāya aññatra puññakiriyāya
sn3.25:4.4: yāni tāni bhante raññaṃ khattiyānaṃ muddhāvasittānaṃ issariyamadamattānaṃ kāmagedhapariyuṭṭhitānaṃ janapadatthāvariyappattānaṃ mahantaṃ paṭhavīmaṇḍalaṃ abhivijiya ajjhāvasantānaṃ hatthiyuddhāni bhavanti
sn3.25:4.5: tesampi bhante hatthiyuddhānaṃ natthi gati natthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe
sn3.25:4.6: yānipi tāni bhante raññaṃ khattiyānaṃ muddhāvasittānaṃ …pe…
sn3.25:4.10: tesampi bhante pattiyuddhānaṃ natthi gati natthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe
sn3.25:4.11: santi kho pana bhante imasmiṃ rājakule mantino mahāmattā ye pahonti āgate paccatthike mantehi bhedayituṃ
sn3.25:4.12: tesampi bhante mantayuddhānaṃ natthi gati natthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe
sn3.25:4.13: saṃvijjati kho pana bhante imasmiṃ rājakule pahūtaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ bhūmigatañceva vehāsaṭṭhañca yena mayaṃ pahoma āgate paccatthike dhanena upalāpetuṃ
sn3.25:4.14: tesampi bhante dhanayuddhānaṃ natthi gati natthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe
sn3.25:4.15: adhivattamāne ca me bhante jarāmaraṇe kimassa karaṇīyaṃ aññatra dhammacariyāya aññatra samacariyāya aññatra kusalakiriyāya aññatra puññakiriyāyāti.
sn3.25:5.2: adhivattamāne ca te jarāmaraṇe kimassa karaṇīyaṃ aññatra dhammacariyāya aññatra samacariyāya aññatra kusalakiriyāya aññatra puññakiriyāyāti.
